Good to be in Tempe this afternoon to help kick off the annual @auntritas AIDS walk.

I’ll keep working in Congress to secure more resources for preventative care and treatment. Together we can end HIV and AIDS for the next generation. https://t.co/9j5XxHpoMx

#ColorectalCancer is expected to become the number one cancer killer for people under 50 in the next decade. More than 3,100 Arizonans will be diagnosed this year alone.
 
I'm working to make sure federal funding, research and treatment options keep pace. @FightCRC https://t.co/rRokNm1Vj8

Today I presented $990,000 in community project funding to @chandlerazmayor to support @cityofchandler's water conservation efforts.

These federal funds I secured will help install smart water meters and help facilities like the Pecos Water Treatment Plant better manage water. https://t.co/FpsfCMWcws

Although there are wide-ranging personal opinions about abortion, most Americans agree the government has no business getting between a woman and her doctor.

That is what is at stake here: The constitutional right for women to exercise control of their own bodies. https://t.co/YuimYStaL1

Making sure Arizona parents have access to safe, affordable infant formula is urgent, and I'm working to ensure that all babies have the nutrition they need to be healthy and grow.

I voted yesterday to get @US_FDA the emergency funding it needs to address this shortage.

Water security is critical to the continued growth of our economy & we have to make every drop count. 

Proud to partner with @intel & @chandlerazmayor to bring $3M in funds for a new water treatment facility that’ll support Intel’s growth while conserving groundwater. https://t.co/9UoJps95GE

Water security is economic security.

Proud to work with @chandlerazmayor to bring home $3 million in federal funding for a new water treatment facility—helping make Chandler more resilient to drought and supporting @Intel's expansion in the East Valley. https://t.co/d2ZqwKwhNo

Delivered +$37M to bring the Kyrene Water Treatment Facility back online! 

Glad to have great partners like @ASACivilWorks + @mayorcoreywoods who make investments like these a top priority. Our work is paramount in shaping a more sustainable future for generations to come. https://t.co/8INuCopRHp

It's no secret that Arizona is facing a historic drought, and our future depends on how well we respond.

That's why I'm working directly with cities to make every drop of water count, like securing $37.5M to reopen a key water treatment facility in Tempe. https://t.co/LK7oyTlfws

On #WorldAIDSDay , we mourn the lives cut short by this terrible disease and honor the resilience of those living with HIV.

Not only must we continue working to end the epidemic, we must also work to end the stigma and ensure access to treatment and prevention. https://t.co/SW7k8icmEZ

Asking for help when you need it is a sign of strength, not weakness. Wishing Senator @JohnFetterman all the best during his treatment. 

If you or someone you know is struggling with mental health, know you're not alone. Resources are available at https://t.co/9lNGlIlwVg.

Today marks the first day of summer! Keep yourself and your loved ones safe with these tips to beat the heat. ☀️⬇️

https://t.co/Zv5pTVut5X
🌡️ The Valley remains under an excessive heat warning. Visit https://t.co/Yjw5Yy8jHH for resources to stay cool—and to find cool-off and hydration centers.

At @terroshealth's new CAFÉ Stapley, East Valley teens and families will be able to access comprehensive mental health & substance use treatment.

I'm so proud to have secured $600,000 in federal funding to make this project possible. https://t.co/jLrt2VvkI4

$3 million under my Arizona Environmental Infrastructure Authority is headed to the Yavapai-Apache Nation to help construct a wastewater treatment plant—a key part of their water conservation efforts. My team joined Chairwoman Lewis and @LADistrictUSACE for the signing ceremony. https://t.co/ymuNP7BSUr

🏃‍♂️ Got my workout in with 5th & 6th graders at Lincoln Elementary School as part of the We Run Mesa program! 6 years ago, local mom Nycole Leyba built this incredible organization and has worked to create connections between Mesa PD & Fire and kids in the community. 
@TheRunnerMama

I’m bringing @NativeHealthPHX CEO Walter Murillo as my guest to President Trump’s Joint Address tonight. Native Health has served thousands of patients at their community health centers, and many of those patients rely on Medicaid to pay for their treatment.

The Republican cuts to Medicaid will be devastating for the patients they serve.

The cruelty & lawlessness of this administration is on full display.

Deporting U.S. citizens is illegal. Separating families & withholding medication from a child undergoing cancer treatment is immoral. Denying due process is brazenly unconstitutional.
https://t.co/0F8anTJ8YU

Republicans failed to pass their own budget that slashes health care and nutrition assistance for millions of working families—all to fund more billionaire tax breaks. Americans ain't buying what they're selling. We won't back down.

Billionaires get the tax break—working families get the bill. The GOP tax scam would rip health care from seniors, cut nutrition aid for kids, and explode the deficit by $3.8 trillion.

More from @abc15 ⬇️ https://t.co/k1uUtMD0xh
Congratulations to @RubenGallego and @Syd_Gallego on the birth of your son! Wishing your growing family health, happiness, and as much sleep as you can get.

Big news for Arizona’s @SHPbeds! After years of giving kids a place to sleep, they were still waiting on their 501(c)(3) status. They reached out to my office—& we got it done. I had the joy of calling to congratulate them. It’s a big milestone for a group doing incredible work. https://t.co/Ko54tnr2PW

The Republican budget bill is about to push Arizona hospitals and health care systems off a financial cliff.
 
It kills 70,000 construction & clean energy manufacturing jobs in our state.
 
And it rips health care & nutrition assistance away from hundreds of thousands of our neighbors.
 
Arizona Republicans should listen to @GovernorHobbs. Put our state first and vote NO.
Republicans are ripping healthcare away from millions—and shuttering rural Arizona hospitals—to give tax breaks to billionaires. https://t.co/3xMd5DjOfS

For 60 years, Medicaid and Medicare have helped Arizona families access care.

But under Trump’s plan, hundreds of thousands of Arizonans—seniors, children, families—could lose their coverage. 
https://t.co/VWfq1wzQoR
